cohort: The study included 20 pregnant women with early-onset preeclampsia treated with TPE and 21 pregnant women with comparable placental dysfunction who received standard care.
finding: The study found that TPE was associated with longer pregnancy duration, reduced sFlt-1 and sEng levels, and higher fetal survival rates compared to standard care.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at admission was 23.75 +/- 2.26 weeks in the TPE group and 27.57 +/- 2.68 weeks in the control group.
